title: every day or now?
subtitle: Erst das Signalwort suchen
card: Merke: **every day, always, usually** → Simple Present, **ohne** am/is/are. **now, Look!, Listen!** → am/is/are + -ing.

explain.p: Bevor du die Lücke füllst, such das **Signalwort**. Es verrät dir die Zeit.

head: Signalwort
Zeit
Beispiel
rows: every day, every Friday, always, usually, often, never, on Mondays
We **go** to the cinema every Friday.
now, right now, at the moment, Look!, Listen!, Be quiet!
Look! We **are going** to the cinema.

explain.tip: Bei **every day** und Co. gibt es **kein** am/is/are: I **go** to school every day – nicht „I am going …“.
Bei he/she/it bekommt das Simple Present ein **-s**: She walk**s** to school every day.

explain.p: In der **Frage** tauschen die Wörter den Platz:

explain.tip: Nach **Does** steht das Verb **ohne -s**: Does he **like** apples?

exercises.q: At the moment he is reading.
We ___ to the cinema every Friday.
exercises.explain: every Friday → immer wieder → Simple Present **ohne** are: we **go**.
every morning → Simple Present, my mum = she → drink**s**.

exercises.q: Look! Two dogs ___ in the garden.
exercises.explain: Look! → jetzt. Two dogs = mehrere → **are** playing.
In der Frage tauschen die Wörter: What **is she** doing?
on Mondays → Simple Present. Frage mit he → **Does** he play …?
Nach **Does** steht das Verb ohne -s: Does he **like** apples?
every evening → Simple Present, he → brush**es** (nach sh kommt -es).
Listen! → genau jetzt, the birds = mehrere → **are singing**.
right now → genau jetzt, I → **am doing**.
never → Simple Present, my brother = he → clean**s**.
every Friday → Simple Present: We **go** swimming every Friday.
Frage im Present Progressive: What **are you** doing now?
